doc.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023

title: Touring, the Centennial and Dan Brubeck's drumming
summary: Lamb talks about the Covid-delayed Brubeck Centennial, the evolving band, and Dan Brubeck's mastery of time.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: You guys tour a lot and it seems like a successful venture. It was a real drag that the Brubeck Centennial got waylaid by the Covid thing.

Yeah. Yeah we had some very substantial concerts that got — you know the Royal Albert Hall and you know things like that. But when we did start playing again that first year, I guess it was summer of 2021, is that possible? But it was all the make-up gigs for the Centennial so we were on the road constantly. But it’s a blast I love it. I love the band. And the band is evolving too. You know it’s not just stuck in some certain vibe and you play. The improv thing and where we go in that, and you know the trio playing is, you know, it’s really developing, which is really neat you know what I mean? Because you can be okay here we go, we’re going to do this again. But now it’s pushing stuff around musically, rhythm, listening to each other more and it’s very cool.

Dan is quite an amazing guy. I remember here we are sitting on the stage that you all played on and I remember listening, at a couple of moments during that concert — I can’t remember if it was during a solo or what but I got this notion like I think Dan lost the beat. And boy was I wrong.

Well you know, I know what you mean. Yeah I’ve been playing with that cat for 20 years now and, you know, his “Take Five” solo, I mean his playing in general but his “Take Five” solo or his solos are just — I’m going man I’ve heard him do this now I don’t know how many thousands of times and I just shake my head standing there on the side of the stage. This dude is unreal. Nobody plays like that you know. I mean it’s almost like a rock — Ginger Baker hard hitting thing with like this mastery of time. You know you see this crazy dichotomy of stuff. He is pretty extraordinary.
